title: Reviewer Finding Report
description: The canonical wire contract every reviewer subagent EMITS to the primary agent (review-report-standards Rendering 2). The primary agent parses it to merge the swarm, compute the merged verdict, and track fixes across rounds. This file defines the SHAPE and value domains only; the SEMANTICS (severity anchoring, verdict arithmetic, ID stability, status lifecycle, the human rendering) live in the review-report-standards skill. Emit MINIFIED JSON conforming to this schema.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Pinned so a consumer can detect a shape change.

target.description: Files/dirs reviewed. Always a list, consistent with a finding's locations.

generated.description: ISO 8601 date only (no wall-clock time), taken from the date provided in context.

summary.description: Counts. `open` is by severity over UNRESOLVED findings (NEW/OPEN/REGRESSED); resolved/new/ack are orthogonal status counts.

status.description: Position in the cross-round iteration lifecycle.

id.description: Stable, reviewer-prefixed identifier. Assigned once, reused across rounds, never renumbered. PREFIX = the reviewer tag (CC, SEC, TEST, CON, OBS, PERF, COMPAT, PERS, or a language tag e.g. RUST/JAVA).

category.description: Sub-lens tag from the reviewer's OWN controlled vocabulary (not free text). The closed per-reviewer value set is owned by each reviewer agent.

locations.description: One or more `file:line` (or `file:start-end`) sites. An array because a finding may span sites (e.g. duplication).

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 date only, frozen at creation; kept unchanged across rounds.

problem.description: ONE line: what is wrong. Never restate large code.

fix.description: ONE line: the concrete remedy the implementer should apply.

findings.problem: dto->entity mapping duplicated across 3 sites; edits must be made in parallel
findings.fix: extract map_order(); call from all three
